title: ZERO HOUR: Action Thriller Main Theme BGM (original score)
description:
Midnight in Mumbai. A cyber attack blacks out the whole city, block by block. One agent has sixty minutes to reach the control tower and switch it back on: rooftops, a bike chase down the dark highway, a face-off with the hacker... and then the lights come back.

A big-screen action thriller main theme: full orchestra and heavy brass, a male choir, huge cinematic drums with a real thavil, a fiery violin and a bansuri taking the hook, all written in South Indian film style. Use it for action edits, chase scenes, trailers and goosebump moments. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Zero Hour, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
